//: Static only. framework/buildCommand/installCommand are pinned empty on purpose: pyproject.toml sits at the repo root, and left to zero-config Vercel would detect a Python project and try to install Athena itself. There is nothing to build -- site/ is hand-written HTML.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src *; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
